name: Kashino Chinatsu
source: A cheerful, energetic girl who is Sakakibara Tsubasa’s girlfriend. Even after becoming the chairman of the cultural festival committee, she brings her enthusiasm to her new responsibilities. She likes to take things for what they are without judging them, and she doesn’t like to ponder too deeply about difficult subjects. Recently, she finds Tsubasa’s secretive attitude to be frustrating.
